question: What is the annual leave policy for full-time employees at Meridian Dynamics?
answer:
The annual leave policy for full-time employees at Meridian Dynamics includes:
- Casual Leave: 12 days per calendar year, credited quarterly, for short-notice personal matters. [pdf_3a43baec4985aba3_chunk_0000]
- Sick Leave: 10 days per calendar year, may require a medical certificate beyond 2 consecutive days. [pdf_3a43baec4985aba3_chunk_0000]
- Earned Leave: 18 days per calendar year, accrued monthly and eligible for encashment up to 10 days annually. [pdf_3a43baec4985aba3_chunk_0000]
- Maternity Leave: 26 weeks of paid leave as per statutory requirements. [pdf_3a43baec4985aba3_chunk_0000]
- Paternity Leave: 2 weeks of paid leave within 3 months of the child's birth or adoption. [pdf_3a43baec4985aba3_chunk_0000]
- Bereavement Leave: 5 days of paid leave in the event of the death of an immediate family member. [pdf_3a43baec4985aba3_chunk_0000]
- Sabbatical Leave: unpaid leave of up to 6 months available to employees with 5 or more years of tenure. [pdf_3a43baec4985aba3_chunk_0000]
